[RFCS.3.3] The `FactAssert` atom is defined in
`proto/fact_assert.proto`. In an event trace an encoder must write its
`clock_ns` (the monotonic engine clock at assertion, [RFCS.6.6]) and its `seq`
(the event's place in the delivered stream, [LFST.12.1]), as every event atom
carries its own ([RFCS.7.5]). It must leave `rule_name` empty: a `FactAssert`
records a host input, and a fact a rule produces is a `FactEmit`
([RFCS.6a.1]).
